summary: Heron Therapeutics filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026, disclosing a September 23, 2026 multi-product Development and License Agreement with Long Grove Pharmaceuticals, LLC and Capstone Development Services Company, LLC. Heron receives an exclusive US license to import, distribute, sell, and market certain products, plus a non-exclusive worldwide manufacturing license; Capstone supplies exclusivity covenants and backstop obligations. Consideration comprises regulatory and sales-based milestones, royalties, and expense reimbursement. Initial term is ten years post-first commercial sale, with automatic two-year renewals. This is an ordinary in-licensing commercial contract, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
